snippet.title: Evidex: Turn Scattered Evidence into One Traceable Review Pack
snippet.description:
Receipts, field notes, attendance records, photographs and spreadsheets should not remain a folder hunt. Evidex maps a bounded evidence set into one traceable pack for human review.

The pack connects claims to source references, preserves provenance and exposes missing evidence. It supports review; it does not guarantee donor, funder, regulator or audit approval.

Start with one redacted or otherwise non-sensitive evidence folder.
Contact: dio_workflows@outlook.com

Sources and further reading:
- DIO controlled Evidex golden-case evidence table, mapped claims and provenance outputs.
- This video contains illustrative synthetic media; no real client case is represented.
